name: Haven
description: Hides server channels from non-administrators while preserving a permission snapshot for recovery. No deletion, hidden admin grants, or member removals.
end_user_data_statement: Stores server channel IDs and channel permission overwrite snapshots needed for recovery. Does not retain user message content.
install_msg: Use [p]haven inspect, then [p]haven seal, and [p]haven restore to recover. Only the actual server owner can use these commands.
